metadata.title: Server Monitoring and Response

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for observing server behavior, detecting security-relevant events, and coordinating response actions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server telemetry, logging pipelines, detection analytics, alerting mechanisms, and coordinated response interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting Zero Trust pattern defining observation, detection, and coordinated response without granting execution or enforcement authority.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines server telemetry, logs, and alerts as security event data used for detection and decision support, not entitlement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Authoritative control catalog for logging, monitoring, detection, and incident coordination (AU, IR, SI families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guide to computer security log management, defining collection, aggregation, and analysis practices.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Conceptual grounding for intrusion detection and alerting mechanisms.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Incident response lifecycle used to contextualize response coordination without embedding enforcement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance establishing that monitoring and detection inform decisions rather than confer trust.

metadata.remarks: Server Monitoring and Response defines how security-relevant events are observed, analyzed, and escalated for coordinated response. This pattern intentionally does not perform enforcement, remediation, quarantine, or lifecycle actions.

components.title: Server Observation and Telemetry
components.description: Collection of security-relevant telemetry and audit data from servers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of logs to evade detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Comprehensive telemetry collection ensures visibility and accountability.

components.title: Server Detection and Analytics
components.description: Analysis of server telemetry to identify suspicious or malicious activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Malicious command execution detected via behavioral analysis.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Behavioral analytics identify deviations from normal execution.

components.title: Server Alerting and Escalation
components.description: Generation and escalation of alerts based on detection outcomes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Clear alerting prevents underreaction or misinterpretation of events.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security incidents are reported through appropriate channels.

components.title: Server Response Coordination
components.description: Coordination of response actions across security, operations, and governance teams.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Coordinated response limits damage and supports recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incident response actions are coordinated according to defined procedures.
